name: bolt.new AI app-builder landing page by bolt.new
description: A dark landing page where the product itself — a chat prompt box — is the hero CTA, floating on a large electric-blue glow orb with output-type tiles and start-from pills beneath it. The page then alternates quiet full-bleed statement sections with dense card clusters: greyed logo strip, a stat pair (98% less errors / 1000x), a deliberate mid-page colour shift into pink-purple for the design-system feature, a bento grid of 3D-rendered cloud-feature cards, and a persona grid using real product-UI screenshots. Type is a single grotesque sans at a wide scale range, with hierarchy built almost entirely from size, glow gradients and card depth on near-black surfaces; the closing CTA reuses the exact hero prompt module, then the footer dissolves into a giant striped wordmark.
